candidate.name: intraday_exact_close_level_diversity_240m
candidate.equality_semantics: Exact numeric equality of accepted minute close values; no decimal rounding, tick inference, tolerance, binning, normalization or price-level transform.
candidate.time_semantics: Validate the exact 241-row source grid, select only 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00, then discard clock order and evaluate all distinct-clock pairs within the stock-day.
candidate.support_predicate: All 240 selected close values must be finite and strictly positive. Constant and partially repeated close paths remain valid; no positive return, range, variance, distinct-level count or price-change count is required.

nearest_terminal_family_challenges.reason: Price-update share uses only 238 adjacent equality edges and is order dependent. Campaign107 uses every unordered pair of the 240 clocks and is order invariant; adjacency never enters the score.

Occupancy entropy normalizes by the completed-day close range and bins into ten intervals. Campaign107 uses exact close identities, no range denominator, no bins and Simpson pair diversity rather than Shannon entropy.
Round-tenth avoidance references a fixed decimal lattice. Campaign107 is invariant to any injective relabeling of exact close levels and has no decimal or nominal-price anchor.
Affordability is a cross-sectional absolute terminal price-level rank. Campaign107 depends only on repeated identities within one stock-day and not the magnitude of the level.
Frontier innovation is an ordered running-record event. Campaign107 ignores record order and treats every distinct clock pair symmetrically.
Return-order families use adjacent returns, sign states or ordinal motifs. Campaign107 forms no return and is unchanged by clock permutation.
Range-revisit families merge or compare high-low intervals. Campaign107 reads close only and exact identity, with no interval geometry.
Campaign106 counts within-bar high-low variation. Campaign107 uses cross-clock recurrence of close identities and does not read high or low.
Campaign107 reads no amount, volume, VWAP, peer state, quarterly value, Candidate49 value, old factor value, fit, model or combination.

support_predicate_gate.explanation: The candidate requires only the accepted fixed close grid with finite positive values. It does not require positive range, positive return mass, four-quarter history, active-volume count, informative gaps, pair variance, market peer coverage or any previously failed minimum-support predicate.

next_action: Freeze one exact Campaign107 no-return protocol and one single-factor development trial before source values.
